notes: The engines (triage, colorscience, estimation, cardtrust, vision) match Section 6.2 closely. The app layer does not use them: MainActivity hardcodes triageEnabled=false instead of reading the config, decides hard rules in UI lambdas in a different order (R2 before R1, R4 before R3), shows a hardcoded estimate and NO_FURTHER_ACTION from S19, skips the card check and the quality gate, keeps inputs in plain remember with silent defaults (GA 38, age 0 h), and logs hardcoded configVersion, cardBatchId and action names. The fake result is unreachable in v1.0 only because the hardcoded false hides New screening (S09HomeScreen.kt:113). Also: the research PIN is ignored at R01 and R01 is unreachable from Home; S10 pre-sets birth time to 48 h before now; TriageInputs gives the three safety answers a default of false. The 'Certain, verified' tags in 4.3 and 5.6 point to spikes run on a host machine, not reference phones. The inventory was generated at commit 4f04aef; per the prompt, product code is identical to main.
